deployments_detail.use: "Chat-IHI" internal ChatGPT (Azure OpenAI, from Jun 2023); RAG/SLM development
Deep-learning image recognition for aircraft engine damage assessment during disassembly

ILIPS (IHI group Lifecycle Partner System) engine performance monitoring service for civil aircraft engines: collects in-flight engine data, performs trend monitoring, anomaly detection and failure prognostics to plan timely maintenance and support airline operations. Used with customers including Fuji Dream Airlines. [IHI (in-house platform)]

AADS (IHI AI Auto Depalletizing System): a deep-learning-powered robot that recognizes and unloads cardboard boxes from pallets to automate heavy logistics work. Co-developed with IHI Logistics & Machinery and Kinema Systems (USA); launched (commercialized) December 2017, with a domestic logistics customer deploying it in an automated warehouse. [IHI, IHI Logistics & Machinery, Kinema Systems (deep learning)]
3D Laser Radar combined with AI to detect and warn of wrong-way driving and mistaken entries at expressway entrances/exits, distinguishing vehicles from other objects to enhance road safety. [IHI]

AI-based visual inspection for aero-engine and manufacturing parts: a Variational Auto-Encoder for anomaly detection on honeycomb-structure pattern images, plus synthetic-data-generation techniques to train visual-inspection AI models, part of IHI's aero-engine parts plant digitization/quality efforts. [IHI]

Chat-IHI, an internal generative-AI chatbot built on Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service on IHI's private cloud, for document drafting, coding help, summarization, translation, questionnaire analysis and safety risk assessment. Launched June 2023; 3,600 users in the first week, and by March 2025 over 4,000 users (~30% of eligible staff) use it daily out of ~20,000 eligible Group employees in Japan. Uses RAG against internal business data. [Microsoft (Azure OpenAI Service), OpenAI]
deployments_detail.value: 4,000+ daily users (~30% of eligible), 20,000 eligible employees; questionnaire free-text analysis cut from hours to minutes

deployments_detail.use: For IHI Group offices outside Japan (where Chat-IHI is unavailable), internal versions of ChatGPT and Microsoft 365 Copilot are introduced for business productivity; Phase-3 rollout adds per-business-unit LLM frameworks and an on-premises RAG system for departments handling highly confidential information. [Microsoft (Microsoft 365 Copilot), OpenAI (ChatGPT)]

MIMAMORI AI: deep-learning object-detection and image-classification system using ceiling- and workbench-mounted cameras to automatically count factory workers, measure operating hours and classify tasks, enabling workload equalization and productivity analysis. Trialed/installed at IHI Aioi Works. [IHI (deep learning)]

AI equipment anomaly-detection systems: a deep-learning fault-prediction system on PLC operational data (with generative AI for root-cause analysis) plus an abnormal-sound detection system (microphones -> spectrograms -> supervised/unsupervised deep learning). Detects early fire-risk anomalies such as abnormal roller rotation; deployed on industrial machinery including large cranes and at a coal terminal in Fukushima Prefecture where IUK performs maintenance. [IHI (deep learning + generative AI)]
